VERIFIED the wording was self-defeating: a bare section N.M used bare for the qualified form. Rewritten as: a section reference takes the form N.M, which means Chapter N, Section M; bare is gone. Deviation from the literal instruction, disclosed: it proposed declaring a bare section number malformed, but the book legitimately uses the chapter-qualified Ch N section M form 149 times (e.g. Ch. 6 section 3), so that wording would create a new book-wide inconsistency. The rewritten convention documents both forms explicitly, which removes the ambiguity the finding was about.
